law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(g)
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 30 feet upon the approach to any official traffic-control signal located at the side of a highway.

activation_conditions: a traffic-control signal is located at the side of the highway
the subject stops, stands or parks within 30 feet on the approach to it
exceptions: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
in compliance with the directions of a police officer or an official traffic-control device
residue: the 30 feet are measured to the signal head's position, which is a different quantity from the stop line or the intersection boundary
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: judged for every instant at rest inside the 30-foot approach zone
